title: NASA Red
slide_intent: Give suppliers a portable color reference. A repeated, individually labeled swatch can travel with a job and still identify the target it represents.
strategic_value: NASA can specify the same named red to printers and producers working with inks, paints or dyes.
demonstration: Four columns across five rows repeat a red field with its matching instruction. Each specimen carries its own description.
practical_value: Use the labeled physical swatch for a production match. The scan records the layout and wording, while its displayed hue depends on the reproduction and display.

content_islands.name: Swatch array
content_islands.spec: Fill the sheet with a regular four-by-five array. Keep the red fields consistent in size and position.

content_islands.name: Swatch labels
content_islands.spec: Attach the short NASA Red matching instruction above each field so a separated specimen retains its identity and purpose.

reference_purposes.Expression: Twenty repeated red specimens make the named color visible across the sheet.
reference_purposes.Application: Each specimen includes instructions to match NASA Red in inks, paints, dyes or other pigments when it is specified.

ingredient.name: Portable NASA Red swatch
ingredient.role: Keep the color name and matching instruction attached to a separated physical sample.
ingredient.application: Use an original printed specimen as the visual matching target when NASA Red is specified in inks, paints, dyes or other pigments.
ingredient.scope: The manual’s physical swatch sheet. The digital scan documents its construction and instructions but is not a calibrated production target.
